Isn't that right, Lefty and Righty? {{SpeakQuote|(Awww... hahaha!)}}|audio = Null&VoidN2Wave22-2.ogg|'''Narrator''' in [[Banlands]]}} }} ==Description== The '''Narrator''' was a narrator which initially appeared in [[Trick or Threat Town]], then made a return in [[Lunar Overture Event]], appearing in all three of the event maps. Originally, the '''Narrator''' was just a shadowy figure which narrated [[Trick or Threat Town]]. After the events that took place there, the '''Narrator''' at some point started the Solar Theatres, the theater in which all [[Lunar Overture Event]] took place in. In the scrapped [[The Great Finale]] cutscenes, he also with the help of [[Penumbras]] managed to rebuild the [[God Cube]], which lead to him killing [[Penumbras]] and later getting killed himself by [[Lord Exo]], though as [[The Great Finale]] has been made entirely non canon, none of these events took place. In the [[Null & Void Event]], he made an appearance in [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]]. In [[The Final Act Event|The Final Act]], he made an appearance as the Final Boss and Narrator. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Animated |{{Tabber |Version 5 |The '''Narrator''' has a dark body and a white face. He wears a red suit with gold accents, a black vest with gold buttons and a red jabot with a golden star, red top hat with red feathers and golden lines, and golden shoulder-pads. On his face, he wears a white mask with golden accents and red eyes, covering half of his face. He carries a stick with his right hand. |Version 4 |The '''Narrator''' has a glowing pink body with ghostly legs. He wears a dark scarlet suit that consists of a torn tophat and jacket, and a buttoned grey vest. On his tophat, he has two feathers, one grey other purple. On his suit, he also has multiple purple accents. He also wears a black mask, covering half of his face. In multiple of his animations, he can hold a magic wand. |Version 2 & 3 |The '''Narrator''' had a translucent black body with ghostly legs. He wore a dark scarlet suit that consisted of a tophat and jacket, and a buttoned red vest. On his jacket, he had a red flower while his tophat has two feathers, one red other yellow. On his suit, he also had multiple golden accents. He also wore white frilled gloves and had a white mask covering half of his face. In multiple of his animations, he could hold a microphone and a stick. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Narrator''' had black translucent body. He had no clothing, other than a dark scarlet tophat and white frilled gloves. He also had white eyes. He could hold a microphone in his animations. }} |Icon |The '''Narrator''' was a dark, shadowy figure, making him appear as mostly black. NarratorChillGuySticker.png|'''Narrator''' on the [[Narrator Chill Guy |Narrator Chill Guy]] sticker. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CardboardNarrator.png|Cardboard cutout of the '''Narrator'''. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Narrator''' is the second narrator that uses voicelines. *The '''Narrator''' is the first narrator to use a viewport model rather than static renders. *The '''Narrator's''' top hat was turned into an UGC accessory obtained by triumphing [[The Great Finale]], with the accessory being {{RLinkC|15286392354|Narrator's Top Hat}}. *While the same character each time, the '''Narrator''' has had two separate personalities. **During the [[Halloween 2020 Event]], he had a calm, serious and ominous personality, which would change to an energetic, crazy and more narcissistic personality during the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ***The [[Null & Void Event]] mostly kept his personality, though made small changes to him like him breaking the fourth wall multiple times. *The '''Narrator''' appears as a skin in the game ''Forsaken''. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.0]] **'''Narrator''' added. *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]b **Animated version added. *'''31 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]g **Updated '''Narrator''' appearance. **{{Bug}} Neutral animation has a stick that goes through the '''Narrator's''' head. *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **Updated '''Narrator''' animations. **{{Bug}} Spinning animation has no stick that he spins. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **Updated '''Narrator''' appearance. **Animations changed. ***Despair and Aggressive animations added. ***Announcing animation removed. **{{Bug}} Animations do not work. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]]b **{{Bugfix}} Animations now work. *'''19 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]] **Updated '''Narrator''' appearance. {{NarratorNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Narrator}}
